raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Qwen3.5-VL currently forces vision sequence parallelism off. Manually enabling it makes QKV gather an already replicated sequence and produces a RoPE length mismatch. This adds `vision_sequence_parallel=False` independently of language `sequence_parallel`, scatters vision transformer inputs, and restores full patch groups before final/deepstack mergers. Padding has separate attention boundaries and is cropped from merged outputs.

The combined-model provider installs a Bridge-specific `finalize_model_grads_func`. Core still synchronizes DP gradients, handles embeddings and normalizes by token count once. A parameter-filtering view gives Bridge explicit ownership of vision SP sums, preventing both the missing reduction with language SP off and duplicate reduction if Core's global gate changes. The callback also corrects the existing GDN shared output-norm gradient sum when language SP is off. No Core source or submodule-pin change is required.

Training setup preserves the selected callback, rebinds process groups and composes PEFT synchronization without repeating finalization. Defaults and checkpoint parameter names/shapes are preserved. Related to #6662.

Validation:
- Focused units: 341 passed, 1 expected skip in the final single-GPU run (an existing FP8 device-migration test requires two GPUs and passed in the earlier two-GPU run).
- Two H100 ranks, unchanged pinned Core: 16 distributed cases passed per rank. Dense all-four-SP combinations and valid MoE combinations at TP1/TP2; outputs, all parameter gradients, SGD deltas and actual sequence sharding checked. Includes ordinary DDP and overlapped reduction with distributed-optimizer buffers and per-token normalization.
- Against Core PR8538's changed global gate: all 8 full-model matrix cases also passed per rank, checking against duplicate reductions.
- All-files pre-commit passes. A lightweight strict mypy check is incomplete because the workstation lacks PyTorch type information. Fresh independent review completed; bound callback arguments identified during review are preserved and covered by regressions.

Supported added reductions use Megatron DDP with a shared modality TP group. FSDP/DTensor gradients, GTP weight rematerialization and vision SP with CUDA graphs are explicitly rejected where applicable. This does not extend MIMO's separate finalization path. MoE retains Core's existing requirement for language SP when language TP is greater than one.

Checks use tiny random models, mixed image/video frames, odd vision lengths, deepstack and recomputation. They do not establish full-size training, performance/memory gains, distributed MIMO correctness, language packing, or an end-to-end optimizer step; update comparisons use SGD arithmetic on the resulting gradients.

+### Independent vision sequence parallelism
+
+Qwen3.5 dense and MoE providers expose `vision_sequence_parallel` separately
+from the language model's `sequence_parallel`. Vision SP defaults to `False`.
+Each enabled SP option requires its module's tensor-parallel group to have more
+than one rank. Vision SP currently requires `vision_cuda_graph_impl="none"`.
+
+The combined-model provider installs a Bridge gradient-finalization callback;
+no Core change is required. It owns vision SP gradient sums while Core retains
+DP synchronization, embedding synchronization and loss normalization. It also
+sums GDN's shared output-norm gradients across TP heads when language SP is off,
+including when vision SP is off. These parameters are excluded from Core's TP
+reduction pass to prevent duplicate reductions.
+
+The added reductions support Megatron DDP (including its distributed optimizer)
+with a shared vision/language TP group. FSDP, DTensor gradients and GTP weight
+rematerialization are not supported for these reductions. MIMO uses its existing
+per-module finalization path; this callback does not extend MIMO support.
+Custom training loops must call `config.finalize_model_grads_func`, as Bridge's
+training loop does, instead of calling Core's finalizer directly. A conflicting
+custom finalizer is rejected when the added reductions are needed.
+
+For a dense model, enable SP in the vision transformer while leaving language
+SP off:
+
+```python
+cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size = 2
+cfg.model.vision_sequence_parallel = True
+cfg.model.sequence_parallel = False
+```
+
+Core requires language SP for MoE training with language TP greater than one.
+For MoE, keep `sequence_parallel=True` and choose `vision_sequence_parallel`
+independently.
+
+Vision activations are scattered after patch and position embedding and gathered
+before spatial patch merging. The merger keeps ordinary tensor parallelism, and
+complete vision embeddings are inserted into language embeddings before any
+language SP scatter. Variable-length image/video inputs are padded as needed;
+padding receives its own packed attention sequence and is removed from outputs.
+The options do not change checkpoint parameter names or shapes.
+

+"""Gradient finalization for the combined Qwen3.5-VL model."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel, finalize_model_grads
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import GatedDeltaNet
+from megatron.core.utils import get_model_config, unwrap_model
+from torch.distributed.tensor import DTensor
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.qwen35_vl_provider import Qwen35VLModelProvider, Qwen35VLMoEModelProvider
+
+
+def configure_qwen35vl_grad_finalize(config: Qwen35VLModelProvider | Qwen35VLMoEModelProvider) -> None:
+    """Install the combined-model callback, including after an in-process restart."""
+    callback = config.finalize_model_grads_func
+    while isinstance(callback, partial):
+        callback = callback.func
+    if callback not in (None, finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads):
+        if config.vision_sequence_parallel or (config.tensor_model_parallel_size > 1 and not config.sequence_parallel):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Independent Qwen3.5-VL SP requires finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads; custom finalizers conflict"
+            )
+        return
+    if callback is None:
+        config.finalize_model_grads_func = finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads
+
+
+class _FinalizeModelView(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Delegate whole-model operations while reserving selected TP reductions."""
+
+    def __init__(self, wrapped: DistributedDataParallel, owned_parameters: set[int]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.module = wrapped
+        self.ddp_config = wrapped.ddp_config
+        self.owned_parameters = owned_parameters
+
+    def named_parameters(
+        self, prefix: str = "", recurse: bool = True, remove_duplicate: bool = True
+    ) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.nn.Parameter]]:
+        for name, parameter in self.module.named_parameters(
+            prefix=prefix, recurse=recurse, remove_duplicate=remove_duplicate
+        ):
+            if id(parameter) not in self.owned_parameters:
+                yield name, parameter
+
+    def finish_grad_sync(self, force_all_reduce: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.module.finish_grad_sync(force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce)
+
+    def scale_gradients(self, scaling_factor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        self.module.scale_gradients(scaling_factor)
+
+
+def finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads(
+    model: list[torch.nn.Module],
+    num_tokens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    pg_collection: ProcessGroupCollection | None = None,
+    force_all_reduce: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    """Finalize combined-model gradients with independent vision/language SP.
+
+    Core performs DP synchronization, embedding synchronization and token scaling
+    once. This callback owns vision SP reductions and, when language SP is off,
+    GDN output-norm reductions across TP heads. Parameter views exclude those
+    parameters from Core's reductions, preventing duplicate sums independently
+    of whether Core gates its SP reduction on the root config.
+
+    This callback supports ordinary Megatron DDP with a shared modality TP group.
+    MIMO uses its separate per-module finalization path.
+
+    Args:
+        model: DDP-wrapped combined-model chunks.
+        num_tokens: Token count forwarded to Core for loss normalization.
+        pg_collection: Explicit process groups used by the training schedule.
+        force_all_reduce: Forwarded to Core's DP synchronization.
+    """
+    if pg_collection is None:
+        raise ValueError("Qwen3.5-VL gradient finalization requires explicit process groups")
+    root_config = get_model_config(model[0])
+    tp_group = pg_collection.tp
+    parameters: list[torch.nn.Parameter] = []
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    for wrapped in model:
+        raw = unwrap_model(wrapped)
+        vision = getattr(raw, "vision_model", None)
+        language = getattr(raw, "language_model", None)
+        for module in (vision, language):
+            if module is not None and module.pg_collection.tp is not tp_group:
+                raise ValueError("Combined Qwen3.5-VL requires a shared TP group; use MIMO for separate groups")
+        if tp_group.size() <= 1:
+            continue
+        candidates: list[torch.nn.Parameter] = []
+        if vision is not None and vision.config.sequence_parallel:
+            candidates.extend(p for p in vision.parameters() if getattr(p, "sequence_parallel", False))
+        if language is not None and not root_config.sequence_parallel:
+            for module in language.modules():
+                if isinstance(module, GatedDeltaNet):
+                    candidates.extend(module.out_norm.parameters())
+        for parameter in candidates:
+            if not parameter.requires_grad or id(parameter) in seen:
+                continue
+            if getattr(parameter, "average_gradients_across_tp_domain", False):
+                continue
+            if not isinstance(wrapped, DistributedDataParallel):
+                raise ValueError("Independent Qwen3.5-VL gradient reduction currently requires Megatron DDP")
+            grad = getattr(parameter, "main_grad", None)
+            if isinstance(grad, DTensor):
+                raise ValueError("Independent Qwen3.5-VL gradient reduction does not support DTensor gradients")
+            seen.add(id(parameter))
+            parameters.append(parameter)
+
+    if parameters and (root_config.gtp_weight_remat_size > 1 or root_config.expert_gtp_weight_remat_size > 1):
+        raise ValueError("Independent Qwen3.5-VL gradient reduction does not support GTP weight rematerialization")
+    views = [_FinalizeModelView(chunk, seen) for chunk in model] if parameters else model
+    finalize_model_grads(views, num_tokens, pg_collection=pg_collection, force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce)
+
+    # All ranks in this TP group use the same token divisor. Summation therefore
+    # commutes with Core's scaling, and must happen after DP synchronization.
+    # Coalesce by dtype/device without relying on private Core gradient helpers.
+    groups: dict[tuple[torch.dtype, torch.device], list[torch.Tensor]] = {}
+    for parameter in parameters:
+        grad = parameter.main_grad
+        if grad is not None:
+            groups.setdefault((grad.dtype, grad.device), []).append(grad)
+    for grads in groups.values():
+        flat = torch.cat([grad.reshape(-1) for grad in grads])
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(flat, group=tp_group)
+        offset = 0
+        for grad in grads:
+            grad.copy_(flat[offset : offset + grad.numel()].view_as(grad))
+            offset += grad.numel()

+"""Ownership, scaling and callback integration for combined Qwen3.5-VL."""
+
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl import grad_finalize as gf
+from megatron.bridge.training.state import GlobalState

+class FakeGDN(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, sp):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.out_norm = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2, bias=False)
+        self.out_norm.weight.sequence_parallel = sp
+
+
+class FakeDDP(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, raw):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.module = raw
+        self.config = raw.config
+        self.ddp_config = SimpleNamespace(use_megatron_fsdp=False)
+        self.sync_calls = []
+        self.scale_calls = 0
+
+    def finish_grad_sync(self, force_all_reduce=False):
+        self.sync_calls.append(force_all_reduce)
+        for parameter in self.parameters():
+            if parameter.requires_grad and parameter.main_grad is not None:
+                parameter.main_grad.mul_(3)
+
+    def scale_gradients(self, scaling_factor):
+        self.scale_calls += 1
+        for parameter in self.parameters():
+            if parameter.requires_grad and parameter.main_grad is not None:
+                parameter.main_grad.mul_(scaling_factor)
+
+
+def make_model(language_sp, vision_sp, tp_size):
+    pg = SimpleNamespace(tp=SimpleNamespace(size=lambda: tp_size))
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        sequence_parallel=language_sp,
+        vision_sequence_parallel=vision_sp,
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=tp_size,
+        gtp_weight_remat_size=1,
+        expert_gtp_weight_remat_size=1,
+        finalize_model_grads_func=None,
+    )
+    raw = torch.nn.Module()
+    raw.config = config
+    raw.vision_model = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+    raw.vision_model.config = SimpleNamespace(sequence_parallel=vision_sp)
+    raw.vision_model.pg_collection = pg
+    raw.vision_model.weight.sequence_parallel = vision_sp
+    raw.vision_model.bias.sequence_parallel = vision_sp
+    raw.vision_model.bias.average_gradients_across_tp_domain = True
+    raw.vision_model.register_parameter("unused", torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2)))
+    raw.vision_model.unused.sequence_parallel = vision_sp
+    raw.vision_model.register_parameter("frozen", torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2), requires_grad=False))
+    raw.vision_model.frozen.sequence_parallel = vision_sp
+    raw.language_model = torch.nn.Sequential(FakeGDN(language_sp))
+    raw.language_model.pg_collection = pg
+    for parameter in raw.parameters():
+        parameter.main_grad = torch.ones_like(parameter)
+    raw.vision_model.unused.main_grad = None
+    return FakeDDP(raw), config, pg
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("language_sp,vision_sp", [(False, False), (False, True), (True, False), (True, True)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("root_gate", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [1, 2])
+def test_reduction_ownership_and_scaling(monkeypatch, language_sp, vision_sp, root_gate, tp_size):
+    model, config, pg = make_model(language_sp, vision_sp, tp_size)
+    original_buffers = {name: parameter.main_grad for name, parameter in model.named_parameters()}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf, "DistributedDataParallel", FakeDDP)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf, "GatedDeltaNet", FakeGDN)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf, "unwrap_model", lambda wrapped: wrapped.module)
+    sums = []
+
+    def sum_tp(grad, group):
+        assert group is pg.tp
+        sums.append(grad)
+        grad.mul_(tp_size)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf.torch.distributed, "all_reduce", sum_tp)
+    core_calls = []
+
+    def core_finalize(chunks, num_tokens, pg_collection, force_all_reduce):
+        core_calls.append(chunks)
+        assert pg_collection is pg
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            chunk.finish_grad_sync(force_all_reduce=force_all_reduce)
+            # Simulate both the pinned Core gate and a Core version without it.
+            for name, parameter in chunk.named_parameters(prefix="check", remove_duplicate=True):
+                assert name.startswith("check.")
+                if parameter.requires_grad and parameter.main_grad is not None:
+                    if getattr(parameter, "average_gradients_across_tp_domain", False):
+                        continue  # Averaging identical simulated rank values leaves them unchanged.
+                    if getattr(parameter, "sequence_parallel", False) and (not root_gate or language_sp):
+                        sum_tp(parameter.main_grad, pg.tp)
+            num_tokens.mul_(2)  # Model the finalizer's in-place token count update.
+            chunk.scale_gradients(1 / num_tokens)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf, "finalize_model_grads", core_finalize)
+    tokens = torch.tensor(2.0)
+    gf.finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads([model], tokens, pg, force_all_reduce=True)
+    assert len(core_calls) == 1
+    assert model.sync_calls == [True]
+    assert model.scale_calls == 1
+    assert tokens.item() == 4
+    for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+        assert parameter.main_grad is original_buffers[name]
+        if name.endswith("unused"):
+            assert parameter.main_grad is None
+        elif name.endswith("frozen"):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(parameter.main_grad, torch.ones_like(parameter))
+        else:
+            reduced = ("vision_model.weight" in name and vision_sp) or "out_norm" in name
+            expected = 0.75 * (tp_size if reduced else 1)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(parameter.main_grad, torch.full_like(parameter, expected))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+def test_configure_restart_and_custom_callback():
+    model, config, _ = make_model(False, True, 2)
+    gf.configure_qwen35vl_grad_finalize(config)
+    assert config.finalize_model_grads_func is gf.finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads
+    state = GlobalState()
+    state._cfg = SimpleNamespace(model=config)
+    state.reset_for_restart()
+    assert config.finalize_model_grads_func is None
+    gf.configure_qwen35vl_grad_finalize(config)
+    assert config.finalize_model_grads_func is gf.finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads
+    existing = partial(gf.finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads, pg_collection="old", force_all_reduce=True)
+    config.finalize_model_grads_func = existing
+    gf.configure_qwen35vl_grad_finalize(config)
+    assert config.finalize_model_grads_func is existing
+    config.finalize_model_grads_func = Mock()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="custom finalizers conflict"):
+        gf.configure_qwen35vl_grad_finalize(config)
+

+    monkeypatch.setattr(gf, "GatedDeltaNet", FakeGDN)

+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        gf.finalize_qwen35vl_model_grads([model], pg_collection=pg)

+"""Two-GPU TE regression checks for vision sequence parallelism.
+
+Run with ``uv run python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=2 -m pytest
+ tests/unit_tests/models/qwen_vl/test_vision_sequence_parallel_distributed.py``.
+"""
+
+import copy
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel, DistributedDataParallelConfig, finalize_model_grads
+from megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine import TEColumnParallelLinear, TENorm, TERowParallelLinear
+from megatron.core.models.vision.vit_layer_specs import get_vit_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.attention import Qwen3VLSelfAttention
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.transformer_config import get_vision_model_config
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.utils import PatchMergerSubmodules
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.vision_model import Qwen3VLVisionModel
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=[1, 2])
+def pg(request):
+    if int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) != 2 or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("requires two CUDA ranks")
+    owns_group = not dist.is_initialized()
+    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"]))
+    if owns_group:
+        dist.init_process_group("nccl")
+    parallel_state.initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=request.param)
+    try:
+        yield ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+    finally:
+        parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel()
+        if owns_group:
+            dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("merge,deepstack,recompute", [(2, [], None), (1, [], None), (2, [0], None), (2, [0], "full")])
+def test_vision_sp_outputs_gradients_and_updates(pg, merge, deepstack, recompute):
+    hf = SimpleNamespace(
+        depth=2,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_heads=4,
+        intermediate_size=128,
+        patch_size=2,
+        temporal_patch_size=2,
+        in_channels=3,
+        spatial_merge_size=merge,
+        num_position_embeddings=16,
+        out_hidden_size=64,
+        deepstack_visual_indexes=deepstack,
+    )
+    grid = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 2], [2, 2, 4]] if merge == 2 else [[1, 1, 3], [2, 1, 2]], device="cuda")
+    torch.manual_seed(4321)
+    x = torch.randn(int(grid.prod(-1).sum()), 24, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    reference = None
+    for sp in [False, True] if pg.tp.size() > 1 else [False]:
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(1234)
+        parent = SimpleNamespace(
+            recompute_granularity=recompute,
+            recompute_method="uniform" if recompute else None,
+            recompute_num_layers=1 if recompute else None,
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=pg.tp.size(),
+            vision_sequence_parallel=sp,
+            enable_cuda_graph=False,
+            cuda_graph_use_single_mempool=False,
+            cuda_graph_retain_backward_graph=False,
+            cuda_graph_warmup_steps=0,
+            external_cuda_graph=False,
+            use_cpu_initialization=False,
+        )
+        cfg = get_vision_model_config(hf, parent)
+        cfg.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+        cfg.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        cfg.bf16 = True
+        spec = get_vit_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec()
+        spec.submodules.self_attention.module = Qwen3VLSelfAttention
+        model = (
+            Qwen3VLVisionModel(
+                cfg,
+                spec,
+                PatchMergerSubmodules(
+                    patch_norm=TENorm, linear_fc1=TEColumnParallelLinear, linear_fc2=TERowParallelLinear
+                ),
+                pg_collection=pg,
+            )
+            .cuda()
+            .bfloat16()
+        )
+        if reference is None:
+            weights = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
+        else:
+            model.load_state_dict(weights)
+        shapes = []
+        handle = model.decoder.layers[0].register_forward_pre_hook(
+            lambda m, a, k: shapes.append(tuple(k["hidden_states"].shape)), with_kwargs=True
+        )
+        wrapped = DistributedDataParallel(
+            cfg,
+            DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+                grad_reduce_in_fp32=True, overlap_grad_reduce=False, use_distributed_optimizer=False
+            ),
+            model,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+        )
+        wrapped.zero_grad_buffer()
+        inputs = x.clone().requires_grad_()
+        y, extras = wrapped(inputs, grid)
+        loss = y.float().square().sum()
+        for z in extras:
+            loss = loss + z.float().square().sum()
+        loss.backward()
+        finalize_model_grads([wrapped], pg_collection=pg)
+        grads = {n: p.main_grad.detach().float().clone() for n, p in model.named_parameters()}
+        assert y.isfinite().all()
+        assert all(grad.isfinite().all() for grad in grads.values())
+        current = (y.detach().float(), [z.detach().float() for z in extras], grads, inputs.grad.float().clone())
+        assert shapes[0][0] == (x.shape[0] + int(sp and x.shape[0] % 2)) // (2 if sp else 1), shapes
+        assert not model.merger.config.sequence_parallel
+        if reference is None:
+            reference = current
+        else:
+            for n, g in grads.items():
+                base = reference[2][n]
+                scale = base.abs().max().clamp_min(1e-8)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(g / scale, base / scale, rtol=0.02, atol=0.01)
+                # An SGD step must preserve the same update within BF16 gradient error
+                # plus two FP32 rounding steps when subtracting nearby weights.
+                initial = dict(model.named_parameters())[n].detach().float()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    (initial - 0.1 * g) - initial,
+                    (initial - 0.1 * base) - initial,
+                    rtol=0.02,
+                    atol=float(0.001 * scale + 2 * torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps * initial.abs().max()),
+                )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(current[0], reference[0], rtol=0.02, atol=0.002)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(current[3], reference[3], rtol=0.04, atol=0.002)

+def test_qwen35_independent_sp_flag_matrix(pg, moe, overlap, distributed_optimizer, per_token):
+    """Exercise real vision-to-language insertion and root-config gradient finalization."""
+    from transformers.models.qwen3_5.configuration_qwen3_5 import Qwen3_5VisionConfig
+
+    from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.qwen35_vl_provider import Qwen35VLModelProvider, Qwen35VLMoEModelProvider
+    from megatron.bridge.training.setup import _update_model_config_funcs
+
+    torch.manual_seed(4321)
+    pixels = torch.randn(20, 24, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    tokens = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 32), device="cuda")
+    tokens[0, 2] = 101
+    # Each video frame has its own run of vision tokens.
+    tokens[0, 5:7] = 102
+    tokens[0, 9:11] = 102
+    positions = torch.arange(32, device="cuda").view(1, 1, -1).expand(3, 1, -1).contiguous()
+    combinations = (
+        [(False, False)] if pg.tp.size() == 1 else [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True), (False, True)]
+    )
+    if moe and pg.tp.size() > 1:
+        # Core MoE training requires language SP when language TP is enabled.
+        combinations = [(True, False), (True, True)]
+    provider_type = Qwen35VLMoEModelProvider if moe else Qwen35VLModelProvider
+    moe_config = (
+        dict(
+            num_moe_experts=4,
+            moe_router_topk=2,
+            moe_ffn_hidden_size=64,
+            moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size=64,
+            moe_router_load_balancing_type="none",
+            moe_aux_loss_coeff=0.0,
+            moe_permute_fusion=False,
+        )
+        if moe
+        else {}
+    )
+    reference = None
+    for language_sp, vision_sp in combinations:
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(1234)
+        config = provider_type(
+            num_layers=2,
+            hidden_size=64,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_query_groups=2,
+            kv_channels=16,
+            ffn_hidden_size=128,
+            linear_attention_freq=[0, 1],
+            linear_num_key_heads=4,
+            linear_num_value_heads=4,
+            linear_key_head_dim=16,
+            linear_value_head_dim=16,
+            vocab_size=128,
+            make_vocab_size_divisible_by=64,
+            seq_length=32,
+            language_max_sequence_length=32,
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=pg.tp.size(),
+            sequence_parallel=language_sp,
+            vision_sequence_parallel=vision_sp,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            bf16=True,
+            use_cpu_initialization=False,
+            gradient_accumulation_fusion=True,
+            calculate_per_token_loss=per_token,
+            activation_func=torch.nn.functional.silu,
+            mrope_section=[2, 3, 3],
+            rotary_percent=1.0,
+            hidden_dropout=0.0,
+            attention_dropout=0.0,
+            image_token_id=101,
+            video_token_id=102,
+            vision_start_token_id=103,
+            vision_end_token_id=104,
+            vision_config=Qwen3_5VisionConfig(
+                depth=2,
+                hidden_size=64,
+                num_heads=4,
+                intermediate_size=128,
+                patch_size=2,
+                temporal_patch_size=2,
+                spatial_merge_size=2,
+                num_position_embeddings=16,
+                out_hidden_size=64,
+            ),
+            **moe_config,
+        )
+        config.finalize()
+        raw_models = []
+
+        def record_models(models):
+            raw_models.extend(models)
+            return models
+
+        ddp_config = DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+            grad_reduce_in_fp32=True,
+            overlap_grad_reduce=overlap,
+            use_distributed_optimizer=distributed_optimizer,
+        )
+        models = config.provide_distributed_model(
+            ddp_config=ddp_config,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+            pre_wrap_hook=record_models,
+        )
+        model = models[0]
+        raw_model = raw_models[0]
+        _update_model_config_funcs(
+            models, config, ddp_config, optimizer=SimpleNamespace(scale_loss=lambda loss: loss), pg_collection=pg
+        )
+        shapes = {"vision": [], "language": []}
+        handles = [
+            raw_model.vision_model.decoder.layers[0].register_forward_pre_hook(
+                lambda m, a, k: shapes["vision"].append(k["hidden_states"].shape[0]), with_kwargs=True
+            ),
+            raw_model.language_model.decoder.layers[0].register_forward_pre_hook(
+                lambda m, a, k: shapes["language"].append(k["hidden_states"].shape[0]), with_kwargs=True
+            ),
+        ]
+        if reference is None:
+            weights = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())
+        else:
+            model.load_state_dict(weights)
+        model.zero_grad_buffer()
+        output = model(
+            input_ids=tokens,
+            position_ids=positions,
+            attention_mask=None,
+            pixel_values=pixels[:4],
+            pixel_values_videos=pixels[4:],
+            image_grid_thw=torch.tensor([[1, 2, 2]], device="cuda"),
+            video_grid_thw=torch.tensor([[2, 2, 4]], device="cuda"),
+            runtime_gather_output=True,
+        )
+        output.float().square().mean().backward()
+        num_tokens = torch.tensor(32, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64) if per_token else None
+        config.finalize_model_grads_func(models, num_tokens, pg_collection=pg, force_all_reduce=False)
+        grads = {name: parameter.main_grad.detach().float().clone() for name, parameter in model.named_parameters()}
+        vision_grad = next(
+            grad for name, grad in grads.items() if name.endswith("vision_model.patch_embed.proj.weight")
+        )
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(vision_grad) > 0
+        assert shapes["vision"] == [20 // (pg.tp.size() if vision_sp else 1)]
+        assert shapes["language"] == [32 // (pg.tp.size() if language_sp else 1)]
+        assert output.isfinite().all()
+        assert all(grad.isfinite().all() for grad in grads.values())
+        if reference is None:
+            reference = (output.detach().float(), grads)
+        else:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(output.float(), reference[0], rtol=0.03, atol=0.003)
+            for name, grad in grads.items():
+                baseline = reference[1][name]
+                scale = baseline.abs().max().clamp_min(1e-10)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(grad / scale, baseline / scale, rtol=0.03, atol=0.01, msg=name)
+                initial = dict(model.named_parameters())[name].detach().float()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    (initial - 0.1 * grad) - initial,
+                    (initial - 0.1 * baseline) - initial,
+                    rtol=0.03,
+                    atol=float(0.001 * scale + 2 * torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps * initial.abs().max()),
+                    msg=name,
+                )
+        for handle in handles:
+            handle.remove()
+        raw_models.clear()
+        del models, model, raw_model
